Virtus Inv Advisers Incorporated holds 66,993 shares. 121,549 were reported by Ing Groep Nv. General Motors (GM) Rating Reaffirmed
Piper Jaffray now has a $57.0 target price per share on shares of General Motors (GM) . The target price per share would suggest a potential upside of 55.61 % from the previous stock close of General Motors (GM) . This rating was revealed in a note on Tuesday morning.
The stock increased 0.85% or $0.31 $36.94. About 6.50 million shares traded. General Motors Company (GM) has risen 0.46% uptrending. It has underperformed by 11.09% the S&P500.
Analysts await General Motors Company (NYSE:GM) to report earnings on July, 24. They expect $1.82 earnings per share, down 3.70 % or $0.07 from last year’s $1.89 per share. GM’s profit will be $2.57B for 5.07 P/E if the $1.82 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.43 actual earnings per share reported by General Motors Company for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 27.27 % EPS growth.
General Motors Company designs, builds, and sells cars, trucks, crossovers, and automobile parts worldwide. The company has market cap of $52.07 billion. The firm operates through GM North America, GM Europe, GM International Operations, GM South America, and GM Financial divisions. It currently has negative earnings. It markets its vehicles primarily under the Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, GMC, Holden, Opel, Vauxhall, Baojun, Jiefang, and Wuling brand names.
